description: Site admins only (needs an 'admin'-scoped token). Backup and restore-drill health: whether the newest backup set is verified on an offsite target and how old it is, whether offsite copies are immutable (Object Lock), when a restore drill last passed, whether the backup worker is running, plus targets (host/bucket, never keys), schedule and recent runs. A stale, failed, local-only or never-drilled backup reads RED. Pass start: 'backup' or 'drill' to queue one for the worker (picked up within 15 minutes; audit-logged). Returns {health, reasons, targets, problems, schedule, runs, started?}.
name: gluecron_backup_status
